subject: accounting
objective: Break-even for a two-site retailer with a thin margin and a profit target
instruction: A retailer in Northport runs two outlets under one cost base. Over the year its fixed costs are 2860000 USD, covering property, network and central payroll. Each item sold carries 46 USD of buying, handling and packaging cost and is sold for 58 USD. The retailer expects to sell 95000 items next year and wants 415000 USD of pre-tax profit. Required: report the break-even quantity in items, the contribution margin per item, the contribution margin ratio, the expected revenue, the margin of safety in items and as a percentage of expected volume, the quantity needed for the profit target, and the revenue at the break-even point.
